senses.definition: A milk-based product stiffened by a bacterium-aided curdling process, and sometimes mixed with fruit or other flavoring.

quotes.text: Moroccan curried crab and streaks of minty, lemony yogurt add luxury to a supersimple zucchini soup ($14).
